word-town-hall.def: the building where the local government of a city works

word-fire-station.def: a building where firefighters and their trucks wait for emergencies

word-mosque.def: a building where Muslims go to pray

word-synagogue.def: a building where Jewish people go to pray and study

word-cathedral.def: a very large and important church led by a bishop

word-laundromat.def: a public place where you wash and dry your clothes in coin-operated machines

word-art-gallery.def: a building or room where paintings and other art are shown to the public

word-nightclub.def: a place that stays open late at night, with music, dancing and drinks

word-old-town.def: the oldest part of a city, often with historic buildings and narrow streets

word-skyscraper.def: a very tall building with many floors

word-apartment-block.def: a large building divided into many homes on different floors

word-avenue.def: a wide street in a city, often with trees along the sides

word-pedestrian-zone.def: a part of a city where cars cannot go, so people can walk safely

word-bench.def: a long seat for several people, usually outdoors

word-fountain.def: a structure that shoots water into the air, usually in a park or square

word-opposite.def: on the other side of something, facing it

word-city-block.def: an area of buildings with streets on all four sides

word-tourist-information.def: an office where visitors can get maps and advice about a place

word-landmark.def: a building or place that is famous and easy to recognize

word-outskirts.def: the parts of a city that are farthest from the center

word-passeggiata.gl: passeggiata: Italian leisurely evening or Sunday stroll to see and be seen
